text:
maria: FYI customer reported duplicate payments and duplicate tool executions when they call our /v1/generate endpoint. They say the first response was 202 Accepted and later the same operation re-ran. 
kevin: do we have a request_id or customer request example?
jen: any chance this is the function-calling fallback path? If schema validation rejects it, runtime might fallback to non-tool then a client retry could trigger the tool again.
maria: request id from the customer's app: req_0a9c3b (they included it in logs). Attaching the payload they used below. They said client retried after a 5xx from us.
maria: ```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Headers: { Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxx, Idempotency-Key: none }
Body: {
  "model": "open-foo-1",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "charge account 1234 for invoice 987" }],
  "tools": [{ "name": "payments.charge", "arguments": { "amount": 1200 } }]
}
```
kevin: I see they omitted the nested "currency" field. Our tools schema requires {amount, currency, idempotency_key} for payments. If schema validation fails server-side, we sometimes route to the fallback path (non-tool execution) which returns a 4xx/5xx depending on validation stage. The client retried when they saw an error and the retry hit a different path that did accept the tool invocation.
lee: can you paste the server logs for req_0a9c3b?
maria: logs: ```
[2025-07-12T14:02:10Z] req=req_0a9c3b svc=runtime route=/v1/generate status=202 "queued for tool execution" worker=pool-7 tx=txn_8b1
[2025-07-12T14:02:11Z] req=req_0a9c3b svc=runtime tool=payments.charge validation=error details="missing currency"
[2025-07-12T14:02:11Z] req=req_0a9c3b svc=routing fallback=non-tool reason="validation" status=200
[2025-07-12T14:02:16Z] req=req_0a9c3b svc=api-gw status=502 upstream=runtime
[2025-07-12T14:02:18Z] req=req_0a9c3b-retry svc=api-gw status=200 body="ok" tool_exec=payments.charge tx=txn_8b2
[2025-07-12T14:02:19Z] txn=txn_8b2 svc=payments status=success charge_id=ch_42
```
jen: that pattern explains double-exec: initial request partially validated then routed to fallback (so no tool call), but the client observed a transient 502 and retried — the retry took a path that executed the tool successfully. Because the customer didn't provide an idempotency key, we did not dedupe.
kevin: urgent ask: add a quick repro and confirm whether fallback path ever calls the tool downstream. Also check whether our middleware marks the original request as "tool scheduled" even when validation fails.
maria: repro steps I gave customer: 1) send malformed tool args (missing currency) 2) force a 502 by killing the runtime pod during validation 3) re-send same request without idempotency key. They reproduced it locally.
lee: likely fixes: a) ensure tool execution is strictly gated after full schema validation and after idempotency dedupe passed, b) ensure fallback-to-non-tool path does not leave the tool scheduled, c) require idempotency-key for any tool-invoking request or auto-generate and return it in 202 responses.
kevin: for immediate support response: offer refund and mark customer billing exception. Also advise client to include Idempotency-Key header; we'll follow up with engineering.
maria: done — told customer we'll refund and open eng incident. They want reproduction steps so I'm pasting our minimal curl they used.
maria: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"open-foo-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"charge"}],"tools":[{"name":"payments.charge","arguments":{"amount":1200}}]}'
```
jen: can eng add an assertion in runtime: if tool validation fails -> ensure no queued tx and return a 4xx consistently (not 202 then fallback). That will help clients know not to retry. Also log an operation id that clients can pass back.
lee: I'll create INC-2025-58 and tag runtime + payments. Priority P1 for duplication/billing. Also adding a short-term mitigation: if we return 202 for tool scheduling we must write an idempotency token into the response body (generated by gateway) so retries are deduped.
kevin: for the incident ticket we'll include these attachments: customer logs, server logs, curl repro, and suggestion to enforce required fields at gateway.
maria: assigning to @lee to open ticket, @jen to add validation check. 
deployer-bot: deploy scheduled to runtime-staging at 2025-07-12T16:00Z for the validation hotfix :eyes:
support-bot: noted — refund issued for cust=acct_992, ticket created INC-2025-58.
kevin: thanks everyone, keep me posted. :thumbsup:
